status: Frozen before any v10 or v11 scored model comparison
baseline: The current locally accepted policy: v7 on valid AOBT, guarded weight-1 movement correction on the disjoint missing-clock mask
weights: Each alternative keeps its own already specified January/July-selected coarse weight; no additional weight search
prerequisites: Each alternative must pass its fixed original January/July and November/December model gates and matched April/October audit
compatibility_formula: On valid-AOBT rows, use clip(v7_candidate + fixed_weight*(new_raw_expert-v7_candidate),0); retain the current missing-clock correction and every other current prediction exactly
compatibility_gate: Exact common 672428 unique finite-label OOF IDs, labels, folds, months, timestamps and masks; positive all-finite RMSE gain and paired UTC-day 95% gain lower bound separately on January/July and November/December against the current policy
selection: After both alternatives are terminal, choose the minimum common-universe January/July RMSE among passing compatible alternatives; ties favor unchanged current policy, then v10, then v11
freeze: Publish and seal the selected route and unchanged weight before scoring May/September

reserved_guard.comparator: Refit the unchanged v7 174-feature depth-10 residual architecture with May/September excluded from fitting and internal early stopping
reserved_guard.replacement: Refit only the selected 184-feature architecture with the same exclusions and its unchanged published CatBoost parameters
reserved_guard.prediction: Compare clipped raw v7 refit with clip(v7_raw + fixed_weight*(new_raw-v7_raw),0) on every finite-label valid-AOBT May/September row
reserved_guard.gate: Each month improves RMSE; pooled paired UTC-day 95% gain lower bound is positive; exact heldout coverage and model/source/prediction provenance are mandatory
reserved_guard.failure: Retain the current policy; do not retune the failed formula or select another alternative using the guard result
reserved_guard.scope: Fixed component architecture check; legacy training and prior data-quality checks mean this is not an untouched complete ensemble performance estimate

february_august: No outcome on these labels selects the v10/v11 features, architecture, weights or routes
final_fit: Only a selected guarded replacement may fit all eligible 2025 rows; use the integer median of its two original complementary-fold tree counts
ranking: Preserve the fixed missing-clock correction and all rows outside valid AOBT exactly; exact template order, finite nonnegative values, source/model/input hashes and readback proof precede finalization
publication_and_submission: Publish source, fixed selection and aggregate evidence before CLI submission; fresh official quota, increasing version and bucket size checks apply
leaderboard_use: Receipts and ranks only report progress after policy and file freezing; no leaderboard feedback selects models, weights, routes or checks
input_integrity: Require these exact baseline, spec and source hashes before and after all later compatibility comparisons and before sealing selection. Future implementation source is separately published and frozen before comparisons.
